name: AIRize: Content summarize with AI
author: Sohel Rana

sections.description:
AIRize is a powerful WordPress plugin that enhances your content by adding convenient AI summary buttons. Users can easily summarize your pages and posts using their favorite AI providers with just one click.

Key Features

  • Multiple AI Providers: Support for ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, and Grok (X/Twitter)
  • Customizable Design: Choose from 4 beautiful design styles
  • Flexible Display: Show buttons on pages, posts, or both
  • Custom Branding: Customize button text, colors, sizes, and add provider icons
  • Optional Intro Text: Add text before the buttons (e.g. “Summarize with:”)
  • Smart Positioning: Control where buttons appear (before content, after content, or both)
  • Mobile Responsive: Looks great on all devices
  • Easy Setup: Simple settings page with live preview
  • WordPress Standards: Built following WordPress best practices

How It Works

AIRize automatically adds AI summary buttons to your content. When visitors click these buttons, they’re redirected to their chosen AI provider with:
* Your custom prompt text
* The current page URL
* Your site name as the source reference

Supported AI Providers

  • ChatGPT – OpenAI’s conversational AI
  • Google Gemini – Google’s AI assistant
  • Perplexity – AI-powered search engine
  • Grok – X (Twitter) AI assistant

Design Styles

  1. Clean & Modern – Minimalist white buttons with subtle borders
  2. Rounded & Colorful – Colorful rounded buttons with shadows
  3. Minimal & Compact – Simple compact design
  4. Bold & Prominent – Eye-catching gradient buttons

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. It only creates redirect links to external AI providers when users click the buttons. Users will be redirected to:
* ChatGPT (OpenAI)
* Google Gemini (Google)
* Perplexity (Perplexity AI)
* Grok (X/Twitter)

Please review the privacy policies of these external services if you have concerns about data handling.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/airize/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > AIRize to configure the plugin
  4. Choose your preferred AI providers and customize the appearance
  5. Save settings and enjoy AI-powered content summaries!
sections.faq:
Do I need API keys for AI providers?

No! This plugin creates redirect links to AI providers. No API keys or subscriptions required.

Will this slow down my website?

No, the plugin is lightweight and only adds a small amount of CSS and JavaScript.

Can I customize the button appearance?

Yes! You can customize colors, text, sizes, and choose from 4 different design styles.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The plugin is fully responsive and looks great on all devices.

Can I control where the buttons appear?

Yes, you can choose to show buttons before content, after content, or both. You can also choose to show them on pages, posts, or both.
